newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech Corp Q4 net up.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech Corp Q4 net up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 net before one-time adjustments $552 million vs $501 million.
Q4 1996 EPS before one-time adjustments $1 vs $0.90.
Results as reported for Q4 1996 included $18 million, or $0.04/shr, after-tax gain on sale of interest in Centertel.

Results as reported for Q4 1995 included $132 million pretax restructuring charge ($88 million after-tax, or $0.16/shr) for planned work force reductions due to data center consolidations, increased costs related to work force restructuring started in 1994, and charge to write down certain data processing equipment to net realizable value.
12-mos 1996 net before one-time adjustments $2.116 billion vs $1.88 billion.
Results as reported for 12-mos 1996 included $18 million, or $0.04/shr, after-tax gain on sale of interest in Centertel.

Results as reported for 12-mos 1995 included $135 million pretax restructuring credit ($79 million after-tax or $0.14/shr) on net settlement gains associated with lump-sum pension payments from nonmanagement pension plans to former employees, partially offset by increased costs related to restructuring and charge to write down data processing equipment to net realizable value.
Results as reported for 1995 include $66 million pretax gain ($41 million after-tax or $0.08/shr) on exchange of minority interests in certain cellular partnerships.
